about_the_game:
Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.

Features

  • Synergy composition & team building: Recruit powerful allies and create your team composition navigating an in-depth synergy system! Arrange powerful combinations to exploit and escalate your power level to cruise through the gates of hell.

  • Loot & itemize: Relinquish your foes and pick up powerful items to fine-tune your composition. Carefully weigh the pros and cons of each artifact and use unique interactions to give you the edge.

  • Explore the underworld: Find your way through the circles of hell under the guidance of our local, friendly red-hooded figure. Beware of your choices, penguin, as decision-making is the deciding factor between facing the unpleasant and the unrelenting.

Bobo In Hell at release will ship with: 

  • 165+ character cards.

  • 50+ unique items.

  • 50+ action cards.

  • 20+ unique enemies.

  • 20+ synergetic archetypes.

  • Hundreds of different viable builds and combinations.

content_descriptors.notes: Depictions of violence, demons and other religious symbology.
